jobs.title: Clinical Manager Lumenis HQ
jobs.description: Lumenis is a global leader in energy-based solutions for Aesthetics and Eye Care. Headquartered in Yokneam, Israel, with offices in Tel Aviv, Lumenis has a strong global presence and business performance worldwide.We are looking for a Clinical Manager to join our Aesthetics Business Unit, which includes a broad portfolio of leading market solutions as well as an exciting innovation pipeline.The Clinical Manager will be responsible for pre-market and post-market clinical activities for the assigned platform, including defining clinical requirements to guide design input, leading pre-clinical validation planning and execution, providing clinical input to regulatory submissions, supporting market conditioning for new solutions, generating post-market clinical evidence, and developing relationships with key opinion leaders.This role is a key pillar in demonstrating the clinical value, safety, performance, and benefits of Lumenis solutions, while strengthening relationships with global KOLs, clinical investigators, and cross-functional stakeholders.Key responsibilities:Develop and manage end-to-end clinical project plans, timelines, and budgets, from early clinical research and pre-clinical validation through clinical trials, publications, user guidelines, and post-market evidence generation.Drive cross-functional collaboration across multiple interfaces and business units.Conduct deep clinical and scientific assessments, including review of the standard of care, clinical trends, mechanism of action, and emerging technologies, to support current and future product development and innovation.Define pre-clinical validation strategies and lead pre-clinical evaluation activitiesLead the strategy, planning, and execution of clinical studies, ensuring adherence to study protocols, ethical requirements, Good Clinical Practice, regulatory requirements, timelines, and budgets.Form and cultivate strong collaborative relationships with cross-functional partners in R&D, product management, marketing, regulatory affairs, quality assurance, clinical training, and regional commercial teams.Lead clinical input and support for key regulatory submissions and processes, including clinical rationales, clinical validations, clinical evaluation reports, and clinical development plans.Support marketing and commercial activities from a scientific and medical perspective, including review and input into marketing collateral, development of white papers, clinical summaries, presentations, training materials, and active participation in scientific meetings.Communicate project status to stakeholders, providing clear updates on milestones, deliverables, risks, mitigation plans, and key decisions.

jobs.title: Clinical Trainer UK & Europe
jobs.description: ﻿About LumenisLumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment.Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world.The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.﻿About the roleAs a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions. The position includes both the UK territories (50% of the time), as well as supporting our activities in Europe (the other 50%).﻿﻿Main Duties and responsibilitiesProvide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow them up.Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director and the EMEA and LATAM Clinical Team to implement and uphold rigorous high-quality standards in training.Coordinate all local clinical events.Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis Aesthetic portfolio products to the customers.Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement. Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.Contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc.The position involves traveling throughout the UK, as well as in Europe, based on the business' needs and as per a pre-established schedule mutually agreed upon with the Clinical Training Director

jobs.title: Marketing Admin (Student Rule) Lumenis HQ
jobs.description: Job Summary: We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Marketing Admin to join our dynamic marketing team. This is a student role, ideal for a BA student in Communication, Business Management, or Marketing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring all marketing materials comply with company regulations, managing vendor relationships, and handling various administrative tasks to support the marketing team.Key Responsibilities:Raising and Approving Materials: Ensure all marketing assets comply with company regulations and legal requirements. This includes obtaining necessary approvals for all marketing materials.Vendor Management: Manage relationships with vendors, including raising purchase orders and ensuring timely delivery of services and products.Content Uploading: Upload marketing materials to the company’s various channels, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.Team Support: Assist with any other responsibilities delegated by the marketing team to ensure smooth operations and successful execution of marketing campaigns.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager EU EMEA
jobs.description: At Lumenis, our commitment to excellence and innovation is driven by the energy of more than 1,000 professionals worldwide. This is what allows us to deliver groundbreaking innovations in the ophthalmology and aesthetic fields and to be recognized as the undisputed world leader in energy-based medical devices.Headquartered in Israel, we are a truly innovative and international organization with a solid global footprint in developed as well as emerging markets, such as the United States, Germany, Italy, United Kingdom, China & Hong Kong, Japan, India, Australia, Korea, Singapore, and Taiwan.About the roleThe Regional Sales Manager is responsible for driving sales performance through a network of distributors across assigned European markets.The role focuses on maximizing revenue and profitability by developing strong distributor partnerships, implementing effective sales strategies, and ensuring sustainable business growth. The Regional Sales Manager works cross-functionally with Marketing, Clinical and other internal stakeholders to execute commercial initiatives and expand Lumenis' market presence.Territory scope may evolve over time according to business needs.﻿Main duties and responsibilitiesDevelop and execute sales strategies through distributor partners across assigned European markets.Develop and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and other strategic stakeholders.Drive market expansion and strengthen Lumenis' market position across the assigned region.Accurately forecasts annual, quarterly and monthly revenue streams.Coordinate cross-functional resources (Marketing, Clinical, Service and Operations) to support commercial success.Ensure distributors are effectively trained on products, value proposition and commercial strategiesMonitor distributor performance through KPIs and implement improvement plans where needed.Analyze market trends, competitive activity and business opportunities, translating insights into action plans.Represent Lumenis at congresses, customer meetings and industry events.

jobs.title: Assistant Controller- EMEA Lumenis HQ
jobs.description: Lumenis is a global leader in energy-based solutions for Aesthetics and Eye Care. With more than 1000 employees worldwide and sales in over 100 countries, we are headquartered in Yokneam and have offices in Tel-Aviv.We are looking for an Assistant Controller for the Finance Accounting team. The Assistant Controller – EMEA role is responsible for managing accounting activities across multiple regional entities, ensuring accurate financial operations and compliance with local regulations and company standards. The position supports financial reporting, closing processes, audits, and cross-functional collaboration, while driving process improvements and adopting new technologies.If you want to work in an innovative, international environment and help push the boundaries of healthcare, well-being, and energy-based technology, this is your opportunity!Main Responsibilities :Responsible for accounting activities across selected EMEA entities, including:• Managing day-to-day accounting operations and ensuring compliance with company policies, local regulations, and accounting standards.• Processing and monitoring vendor, payroll, and other financial payments accurately and on time.• Supporting local teams on accounting and finance-related matters.• Coordinating external audits, including preparation of supporting documentation and communication with auditors.• Assisting with monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes, including journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and reconciliations.• Preparing reporting packages, working papers, and financial analyses, including balance sheet and profit & loss reviews.• Supporting statutory reporting, tax compliance activities, and resolution of accounting discrepancies.• Participating in process improvement initiatives and finance projects as required.
